versions.author: Acme Cloud Inc.
versions.name: Acme_Cloud-Service-Agreement_v3.docx
versions.note:
Our answer to your changes in v2. Version v3 is attached, unsigned.
- Payment Period: we propose new wording, see the attached version. We can move from 30 to 45 days, which is the longest we offer.
- General Cap Amount: not accepted; our original wording is restored. We keep the cap at 12 months of fees, our standard for all customers.
- § 5.5.b: not accepted; our original wording is restored. We need to keep the deletion clause; it is required for GDPR compliance.

versions.author: Acme Cloud Inc.
versions.name: Acme_Data-Processing-Agreement_v3.docx
versions.note:
Our answer to your changes in v2. Version v3 is attached, unsigned.
- Subprocessor Notice Period: not accepted; our original wording is restored. We keep 30 days' notice with your right to object.
- § 3.1.a: not accepted; the new clause is taken out. We cannot commit to EU-only processing; transfers are covered by the SCCs.
- § 4.1: we propose new wording, see the attached version. We can commit to 48 hours, with details provided in phases.
